project: Class A GPCR Structural Pharmacology Atlas

dependencies.note: Pipeline uses the Python standard library only (urllib, json, hashlib, concurrent.futures). No requirements.txt is needed at Phase 1. Any future dependency must be justified in governance/DECISION_LOG.md.

canonical_json.note: Content hashes are computed over canonical JSON with volatile provenance fields removed; see pipeline/common/hashing.py

independence.rule: Read-only. Never imported, never a runtime dependency, never modified.
